user, confirmed in PC-Tool: delay ceiling 20.82 ms on BOTH tiers and they SUM, 2026-07-15

the method's own file is the authority on all of the above: autosound-tuning/knowledge/dsp/helix-dsp-ultra-s.md -- what is here is the machine-readable half the gates read, and it is synced FROM there, never the other way

crossover_filters.corner_freq_note: 20-20480 Hz on EVERY channel, the sub included (user, PC-Tool, 2026-08-23). The sub channel's UI OFFERS 20-300, and higher can still be entered by hand -- so 300 is advisory, not a bound, and must not be written as one: refusing a legitimate sub crossover above 300 Hz is the same class of error as silently rounding LR48 to LR36, inverted.

parametric_eq.mode_note: THE UNION OF THE PC-TOOL MODES, not any one of them (user's rule, 2026-08-23: take the full range everywhere, because it can be entered by hand). Fine EQ pairs a 1 Hz step with Q 0.5-15; the other mode pairs a 0.01 Hz step with Q 0.5-50; the hardware takes 0.01 and 50, and that pair exists in no single screen. So this block answers 'is this enterable on the HARDWARE', and a value it passes may still need a mode switch at the PC-Tool screen. That direction is recoverable; the other one is not -- refusing a setting the hardware accepts means a valid tune is never tried and nobody learns why.
parametric_eq.q_note: What the METHOD should use is narrower still than what the hardware takes, and that is not a hardware question -- see the spatial-validity Q ceiling in the method's diagnostic reference.
parametric_eq.gain_note: the EQ BAND's gain. The channel trim is `channel_gain` below and the two must never stand in for each other.

channel_gain.note: the same range on both tiers (user, PC-Tool, 2026-08-23). Deliberately NOT the EQ band's -30..+12: they are different controls and the asymmetry is the proof.

phase_control.scope: per driver output, all drivers except midbass (midbass is the fixed alignment reference)
phase_control.implementation: all-pass filter; exact order/frequency mapping not confirmed from the PC-Tool UI itself
phase_control.cross_reference: autosound-tuning skill's GEMINI.md independently documents this as APF2 (2nd-order all-pass) at the channel's own crossover frequency -- likely-correct, not independently re-confirmed here

polarity.note: double-inversion possible (driver stage + virtual channel stage); net effect cancels if both are inverted

delay.note: the ceiling is per tier AND the two tiers SUM -- enter a delay in one layer only, keep the other at 0 (user, PC-Tool, 2026-07-15).

_open_questions: Chebyshev ripple parameter: is it user-settable, and what range?
DSP compute budget: with up to 60 bands stacked (30 virtual-channel + 30 output) plus crossover + phase + delay, is there a practical ceiling before the 2x295MHz DSP saturates?
channel_gain step_db: the range is user-verified, the step is not -- so a gain is checked against the range and reported as 'step not declared' rather than passed
